title: One transcript, two messages
hook: Predict the result, then reveal the sequence.

knows: DNA and RNA are sequences of chemical building blocks.
doesNotKnow: Alternative splicing can include or omit particular exons. Here, skipping exon B joins A to C, so one pre-mRNA can produce different mature RNA sequences.

misconception: The original sequence and the resulting sequence must have the same interpretation.
objective: Alternative splicing can include or omit particular exons. Here, skipping exon B joins A to C, so one pre-mRNA can produce different mature RNA sequences.

claims.text: Question, answer, diagram and explanation: A pre-mRNA has exons A, B and C. One splice pattern joins A–B–C; another skips B. What is the second message? Alternative splicing can include or omit particular exons. Here, skipping exon B joins A to C, so one pre-mRNA can produce different mature RNA sequences.
Recall: Can different exon combinations yield different mature RNA sequences? Alternative splicing can join exons in different combinations in eukaryotic RNA processing.
The figure is a simplified model and is not to scale.
